scope: First practical Windows tranche, not exhaustive; existing 66-entry cleanup snapshot remains unchanged
ranking: Editorial evaluation priority within category: 1 start here, 2 compare next, 3 specialist/greater operational risk. Not measured superiority or popularity.

tools.name: Process Explorer
tools.windows_support: Current official page: Windows 11+, Server 2019+; v17.21 observed, not installed
tools.standout_features: Handle and DLL ownership investigation; process tree
tools.risk: Elevated inspection exposes process details; termination can lose work
tools.evaluation: Measure time to identify a synthetic locked file versus Task Manager
tools.reuse: Behavioral inspiration only; documentation repository is not a license to copy binary implementation
tools.evidence_status: official documentation inspected; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: System Informer
tools.windows_support: Current official downloads: Windows 10/11, 32/64-bit; Canary separate
tools.license: MIT main repository; audit driver/dependency licenses
tools.standout_features: Detailed resources, process inspection and debugging
tools.risk: Kernel driver and process manipulation require separate informed approval
tools.evaluation: Compare handle diagnosis and idle overhead with Process Explorer on same workload
tools.reuse: Candidate reusable code under MIT notices; isolate privileged driver from UI
tools.evidence_status: official documentation inspected; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Process Lasso
tools.windows_support: Current official download: Windows 10/11/Server; x86-64, x86-32, ARM64; stable 19.0.0.94 observed
tools.license: Proprietary; free edition plus paid Pro; current vendor matrix requires commercial license within 30 days
tools.standout_features: Persistent process rules, CPU affinity/sets and ProBalance
tools.risk: Scheduler/power changes can worsen particular workloads; no universal FPS claim
tools.evaluation: Randomized baseline versus one rule: p95 input latency, build time, power and rollback
tools.reuse: Behavioral inspiration only; independent policy engine with exportable rules, no proprietary code copying
tools.evidence_status: official documentation inspected; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
tools.windows_support: Current README: Windows 7+ since v5; website older XP/Vista language conflicts; check chosen release
tools.standout_features: Batch uninstall orchestration and leftover review
tools.risk: Leftover detection can include shared data; never bulk-delete unchecked results
tools.evaluation: Disposable VM fixtures: missed leftovers, false positives, shared files preserved
tools.reuse: Candidate adapter orchestration under Apache notices/patent terms; separate inventory from execution
tools.evidence_status: official documentation inspected; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Revo Uninstaller
tools.windows_support: Current FAQ: Windows 7–11 native 64-bit; Free and Pro distinct
tools.license: Proprietary freeware; separate paid Pro terms
tools.standout_features: Built-in uninstaller followed by leftover scan; Hunter Mode
tools.risk: Registry/file cleanup and permanent erase are destructive; restore points are not full backups
tools.evaluation: Compare against BCUninstaller using identical installers and shared-file sentinels
tools.reuse: Behavioral inspiration only; no permission to reuse proprietary code/assets
tools.evidence_status: official documentation inspected; not installed or benchmarked

tools.name: Wireshark
